blocks.text: COTABATO CITY — Unidentified gunmen shot and killed a village councilman and his brother in Barangay Lower Paatan, Kabacan, Cotabato, before dawn Wednesday. The Kabacan municipal police office said the shooting of village councilman Patacpan Maganaka and his brother Ibrahim Maganaka occurred at about 1 a.m., during a village disco event, following an altercation between the official and an unidentified man. Kabacan Mayor Evangelyn de Guzman, who visited and condoled with the family Wednesday morning, has condemned the shooting and directed the police to bring the perpetrators behind bars.
